_about: John's own corrections to the Station exits table, applied last by build_exits_table.py, so they win over the station maps and the map data. Per station: 'names' renames exits (old name: the words used after 'to', as in 'to the town centre and Station Hill'); 'here' says how to put 'is right there' for a renamed exit; 'bridge' is the word for the station's footbridge. Each entry says who and when.

names.Station Hill (north): the town centre and Station Hill
names.Station Car Park: the north exit by the car park on the Caversham side

here.Station Hill (north): The way out to the town centre and Station Hill
here.Station Car Park: The north exit by the car park on the Caversham side
